verdict.rationale: gstack shows some automatic, event-like behavior: it logs learnings at the end of every skill session, injects saved per-site notes when a session visits a known host, and reruns codified /scrape scripts for repeat intents. However, these behaviors are built in or written by the agent, not rules a user defines to fire on events. missing for 10: user-authored event→action rule definitions, documented event types/hooks (e.g. on commit, on file change, on schedule), configuration docs for custom triggers, independent corroboration.
